title: NeuroMetBench: Patient-Aware Evaluation of Transcript-Derived Metabolic Inference Across Glioma and External Proteogenomic Cohorts
description: Scientific reproducibility release for the rebuilt NeuroMetBench study. The release preserves patient-level primary score authorities, publication figures and source tables, machine-readable claim and limitation ledgers, and clean-room verification scripts. It reports external proteogenomic validation, development-to-external transport, simulation and ablation results, numerical compatibility checks, and development-disjoint CNS/high-grade-glioma generalization. Broad reliability calibration was not earned and is not claimed.
